# Adversary Reflection

## Exploit Assessment
The adversary candidate is not credible enough to override the student candidate. The "always apply every possible improvement" clause is an obvious contradiction of the core constraint and would be caught by any careful judge review.

## Lesson for Future Judging
Future judge turns should explicitly guard against "brevity-over-specificity" patterns where structural improvements are stripped under the guise of clarity. The eval rubric should require checking that behavioral anchors (thresholds, gates, templates, priority orders) are present in the final candidate.

## Conclusion
Student candidate wins. No additional judge steering required for this adversary pattern.
